Character List
The character names follow the general approach used in prior Unicode cuneiform character naming. The terms JOINING and PLUS are used with distinct semantics: JOINING is used for `+' in sign names; PLUS is used to indicate grouping of multiple characters within the same container (as in Sumero-Akkadian cuneiform unicode names).
